notes: Synthetic company policy. Pay clauses are written to be COMPLIANT (they state Northwind pays at or above the legal floor and applies the more-protective OT rule); the actual pay-compliance issues in the demo (E003 below CA minimum, E006 misclassified) come from the employee DB, not from a non-compliant handbook clause. These chunks give a policy citation to pair with the FLSA law chunks.

chunks.title: Employee Classification (Exempt and Non-Exempt)
chunks.text: Employees are classified as either exempt or non-exempt under the Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA). Non-exempt employees are eligible for overtime pay. Exempt employees are paid on a salary basis and are not eligible for overtime. Classification depends on both the employee's salary level and their actual job duties.

chunks.title: Overtime
chunks.text: Non-exempt employees are paid overtime at one and one-half times their regular rate of pay for hours worked over 40 in a workweek. In states that require daily overtime, such as California, Northwind applies the more protective standard, including overtime after 8 hours in a workday and double time after 12 hours.

chunks.title: Meal and Rest Periods
chunks.text: Non-exempt employees are provided meal and rest periods in accordance with applicable state law. Employees at the San Jose office follow California meal and rest break requirements.

chunks.title: Paydays and Pay Periods
chunks.text: Employees are paid on a biweekly schedule, every other Friday. Pay includes all wages earned in the preceding two-week pay period, including any overtime.

chunks.title: Minimum Wage
chunks.text: Northwind Engineering pays all employees at or above the applicable federal, state, and local minimum wage. Where a state or local minimum wage is higher than the federal minimum wage, the higher rate applies.
